title: Portable project contract for .github agents and skills
description: Generic, optional-first contract so agents/skills work in any repository. Omit sections that do not apply; prefer discovery when a path is absent.

kit.description: Where the Hyperion kit folder lives inside the product repo. Omit when the kit is at the workspace root (legacy / upstream).

root.description: Relative path from the product repo root to the kit folder (e.g. Hyperion). Cards/skills live under {root}/.github/.

locale.description: BCP 47 / IETF language tag for agent output (e.g. pt-BR, en).

layout.description: Workspace shape. Omit or use single for a simple app repo.

apps.description: Named applications or packages. Keys are free-form ids (api, web, mobile, …).

docs.description: Paths to documentation. All fields optional for simple repos.

requirements.description: Requirements backlog or index file. null means intentionally unset (see project.example.yml).

diagrams.description: Directory for diagrams (PlantUML, C4, etc.). null means intentionally unset (see project.example.yml).

historical_audits.description: Directory of past audit reports (read-only reference).

outputs.description: Where agents write new artifacts. Relative POSIX paths.

diagrams.description: Override for generated diagrams if distinct from docs.diagrams.

stack_hints.description: Optional technology hints. Never treat as hard requirements.

requirement_prefixes.description: Prefixes for requirement IDs (e.g. RF, RNF, US).

finding_prefixes.description: Map audit id (from audits/manifest.yml) → finding ID prefix.

commit_refs_style.description: Optional note on how Refs appear in commits.

overlay.description: Optional markdown with project-specific audit context. null means intentionally unset (see project.example.yml).

ci.description: CI/CD policy — Hyperion never overwrites non-hyperion workflows when policy is detect (default).

policy.description: detect=add hyperion-* only; skip=no workflow writes; hyperion-only=generate product CI if absent; merge=manual integration.

stack.description: Stack hint for generated CI: auto, node-npm, python, docker, go, rust, unknown.

existing.description: Paths to existing product CI files (informational; populated by discovery).

product_ci.description: auto=generate hyperion-product-ci.yml only when no product CI exists.

management.description: Optional project management backend contract (used by integration-bridge and cards-sync multi-backend adapters).

status_map.description: Map Hyperion card status → backend-native status name (optional; fuzzy match used when absent).

email.description: Optional email used for some auth flows.

repo.description: GitHub repository name (optional; can be auto-detected).

commands.description: Repo-adaptive shell commands for agents (test, lint, build, audit). Discovery fills defaults when omitted.

lint.description: Lint command if available. null means intentionally unset.

build.description: Build command if available. null means intentionally unset.

memory.description: Persistent memory capture settings for agents.

auto_capture.description: Append session decisions to DECISIONS.md after agent runs.

uncertainties.description: Open questions Configure mode (/discover, /migrate) couldn't resolve automatically — surfaced to the user instead of guessed.

telemetry.description: Local, opt-in usage telemetry for the agent gates (phase/review/audit/plan/spec-review/release-verify). Off by default; never leaves the machine.

enabled.description: When true, agent-gate verify scripts append an event to .github/plans/telemetry/usage.jsonl (gitignored).

kind.description: ORM / data-layer kind (prisma, drizzle, sequelize, django, …).

schema.description: Path to schema or models entry file.
